newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway shares weighed down by dollar, thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Norway shares weighed down by dollar, thin trade.

text.p: Norwegian share prices took a step back on Wednesday in line with other European markets and on the weaker dollar after disappointing U.S. trade balance figures.
Dealers said activity in some of the blue chips may have been dampened by the expiry of options on Thursday.
The Total share index fell 0.41 percent to 836.29 points in dull turnover of 460.45 million crowns.
"The market is sour today," noted one broker. "Option expiry tomorrow could be holding back some stocks such as Kvaerner and Norsk Hydro."
Seismic and offshore services griuo Petroleum Geo-Services fell a bheavy seven percent to 161 crowns. Analysts said the fall reflected a lack of confidence in the group's plans.
PGS will have a new share issue in the United States at the beginning of October.

"I think it's all about confidence in the management. Their prospectus for the new issue said nothing about floating production systems, an area PGS has pinpointed as an important area for the future," one broker said.
